name: Maksu Online Payments Gateway for WooCommerce
author: Maksu Online Payments

sections.description:
Accept online payments through Maksu directly from your WooCommerce store

The Maksu Online Payments Gateway connects your WooCommerce store with Maksu, a licensed European online payment provider designed for businesses of all sizes.

Add a secure online payment option to your checkout without building a custom payment integration. Once configured, customers can select Maksu during checkout and complete their payment through Maksu’s secure payment flow.

Depending on the payment methods activated for your Maksu merchant account, you can give customers access to cards, digital wallets, local payment methods, alternative payment methods, and Instant SEPA Account-to-Account payments.

Why use Maksu Online Payments for WooCommerce?

Give customers more ways to pay

Offer the payment methods your customers know and trust. Maksu Online Payments supports more than 70 payment methods, including cards, digital wallets, local payment methods, and A2A (Account-to-account) payment options.

The payment methods available in your WooCommerce checkout depend on your country, business type, currency, and Maksu merchant agreement.

Add payments without a custom integration

The WooCommerce gateway provides a straightforward way to connect your online store to Maksu.

Install the plugin, enter the credentials supplied with your Maksu account, and activate the payment gateway from your WooCommerce settings. No separate custom payment integration is required for the standard WooCommerce setup.

Provide a secure payment experience

Maksu Online Payments combines secure payment processing with:

  • 3-D Secure authentication
  • Fraud-prevention capabilities
  • PCI DSS-compliant payment infrastructure
  • Secure transaction processing
  • Merchant and transaction monitoring
  • Regulated European payment services

Maksu is a European Payment Institution licensed by the Austrian Financial Market Authority.

Improve payment operations and cash-flow visibility

Maksu helps merchants manage online payments through a combination of WooCommerce order information and Maksu payment reporting.

Depending on your selected package and merchant agreement, available services can include:

  • Daily settlement cycles
  • Payment reporting and analytics
  • Transaction reconciliation
  • Recurring payments
  • Payment links
  • Network tokenization
  • Multi-language checkout support
  • Dedicated customer success support
  • 24/7 online support

Test the integration before accepting live payments

You can create a Maksu sandbox account and test the payment experience before activating live payment processing.

The sandbox environment allows you to:

  • Install and configure the WooCommerce gateway
  • Connect your store using sandbox credentials
  • Place test orders
  • Test successful, unsuccessful, and cancelled payment flows
  • Check how payment results are reflected in WooCommerce
  • Review the customer journey before going live

** Create a sandbox account here **

Select Create Sandbox account, complete the registration form, and submit your request. Use the sandbox credentials supplied by Maksu to configure the plugin in test mode.

Do not enter real payment details or production credentials while using the sandbox environment.

How the payment flow works

  1. The customer adds products to the WooCommerce cart.
  2. The customer continues to checkout.
  3. The customer selects Maksu as the payment method.
  4. The customer is directed to the secure Maksu payment flow.
  5. The customer selects an available payment method and completes the payment.
  6. Maksu processes the transaction and returns the payment result.
  7. The corresponding WooCommerce order is updated based on the transaction result.

The exact checkout experience and available payment methods depend on the configuration of your Maksu merchant account.

Start accepting payments with Maksu Online Payments

A sandbox account is intended for integration testing only. To accept real customer payments, you must complete the Maksu merchant onboarding and business-verification process.

Start live merchant onboarding, get verified and confirmed in less than 24h
Start live merchant onboarding here

During onboarding, you may be asked to provide company, ownership, website, business model, settlement, and compliance information. Once your merchant account has been approved, Maksu will provide the production credentials required to connect your WooCommerce store to the live payment environment.

Maksu’s AI-powered KYC and KYB onboarding is designed to help eligible merchants complete verification and prepare for live payment processing within less than 24 hours.

Built for growing online businesses

The Maksu Online Payments WooCommerce gateway can be used by:

  • Startups and new online stores
  • Sole traders and small businesses
  • Growing e-commerce merchants
  • Regional and international online retailers
  • Subscription-based businesses
  • Businesses that require local and alternative payment methods
  • High-volume merchants with customized payment requirements

Maksu provides standard packages for smaller and growing merchants as well as customizable solutions for larger businesses and more complex payment environments.

Requirements

Before installing and activating the gateway, make sure that you have:

  • An active WordPress website
  • WooCommerce installed and activated
  • A Maksu sandbox or approved live merchant account
  • The credentials supplied for the selected environment
  • HTTPS and a valid SSL certificate for live payment processing
  • A supported store currency
  • A publicly accessible checkout and payment-return page
  • Permission to install and configure WordPress plugins

Your WordPress, WooCommerce and PHP versions must also meet the technical requirements stated in the current plugin release.

Documentation and support

Developer documentation, APIs, test tools and integration resources are available through the Maksu Developer Portal: https://developer.maksupay.com/

For commercial questions, merchant onboarding, or assistance selecting a payment package, visit: https://maksupay.com/

For integration support, include the following information when contacting the Maksu support team:

  • Your business or merchant name
  • Your WordPress and WooCommerce versions
  • The Maksu plugin version
  • Whether you are using sandbox or live mode
  • The affected WooCommerce order number
  • The approximate date and time of the test
  • The error message displayed
  • Relevant WooCommerce logs, excluding private keys and sensitive credentials

Never send passwords, complete private keys, or live payment credentials through unsecured email or public support forums.
sections.installation:
Before installing the plugin

You will need a Maksu sandbox account for testing or an approved Maksu merchant account for live payment processing.

For new integrations, we recommend starting in sandbox mode, completing at least one successful test payment, and checking the WooCommerce order status before activating live payments.

Create a Maksu sandbox account

  1. Open the Maksu test tools page
  2. Select Create Sandbox account.
  3. Complete and submit the sandbox registration form.
  4. Keep the sandbox credentials and setup information supplied by Maksu in a secure location.
  5. Use these credentials only while the WooCommerce gateway is configured for sandbox or test mode.

Sandbox credentials cannot be used to accept real payments.

Automatic installation through WordPress

When the plugin is available through the WordPress Plugin Directory:

  1. Sign in to your WordPress administration area.
  2. Go to Plugins → Add New Plugin.
  3. Search for Maksu Online Payments Gateway for WooCommerce.
  4. Select Install Now.
  5. When the installation is complete, select Activate.
  6. Go to WooCommerce → Settings → Payments.
  7. Find Maksu or Maksu Online Payments.
  8. Enable the payment method and open its configuration page.

Manual installation

You can also install the gateway manually using the plugin ZIP file.

  1. Download the WooCommerce plugin package from the Maksu Developer Portal: https://developer.maksupay.com/
  2. Sign in to your WordPress administration area.
  3. Go to Plugins → Add New Plugin.
  4. Select Upload Plugin.
  5. Select the Maksu WooCommerce ZIP file.
  6. Select Install Now.
  7. When the installation is complete, select Activate Plugin.
  8. Go to WooCommerce → Settings → Payments.
  9. Find the Maksu payment method and open its settings.

Do not extract the ZIP file before uploading it through the WordPress plugin installer.

Configure the gateway in sandbox mode

  1. Open WooCommerce → Settings → Payments.
  2. Select Maksu Online Payments.
  3. Enable the gateway.
  4. Enable Test Mode, Sandbox Mode or the equivalent testing option shown in the plugin.
  5. Enter each sandbox credential in the corresponding configuration field.
  6. Check that the sandbox or test payment endpoint is selected.
  7. Set the payment-method title displayed to customers, for example: Pay securely with Maksu
  8. Add a short checkout description, for example: Pay securely by card, digital wallet, bank payment or another available payment method.
  9. Save the changes.
  10. Clear any WordPress, WooCommerce, server or content-delivery-network cache.
  11. Open your store in a private browser window and place a test order.

Enter the credentials exactly as supplied. Avoid adding spaces before or after credential values.

Test the complete checkout flow

Before switching to live mode, test the following:

  1. Confirm that Maksu appears as a payment option at checkout.
  2. Place a test order using the sandbox environment.
  3. Complete a successful test payment.
  4. Confirm that the customer returns to the correct order-confirmation page.
  5. Check that the WooCommerce order receives the expected status.
  6. Test a cancelled payment.
  7. Test an unsuccessful or declined payment where supported.
  8. Confirm that cancelled or unsuccessful payments are not marked as paid.
  9. Review WooCommerce order notes and transaction information.
  10. Confirm that the transaction is visible in the appropriate Maksu test environment.

Testing should be completed with caching and optimization plugins enabled, as these plugins can sometimes affect redirects, callbacks or checkout scripts.

Activate live payment processing

To accept real payments:

  1. Start the Maksu merchant onboarding process
  2. Complete the required business and compliance verification.
  3. Wait until your live merchant account has been approved.
  4. Obtain your production credentials from Maksu.
  5. Return to WooCommerce → Settings → Payments → Maksu Online Payments.
  6. Disable test or sandbox mode.
  7. Replace every sandbox credential with the corresponding production credential.
  8. Confirm that the live or production payment endpoint is selected.
  9. Save the settings.
  10. Clear all website and server caches.
  11. Place a low-value live order and complete the payment.
  12. Confirm the transaction in WooCommerce and the Maksu merchant environment.
  13. Refund or cancel the test order according to your internal procedures.

Never use sandbox credentials in live mode or production credentials in sandbox mode.

Recommended checks before launch

Before announcing the payment method to customers, confirm that:

  • HTTPS is active across the complete checkout process.
  • The WooCommerce checkout page is publicly accessible.
  • Maksu is visible for the intended currencies and countries.
  • The payment title and description are clear to customers.
  • Successful payments update the order correctly.
  • Failed and cancelled payments are handled correctly.
  • Confirmation and cancellation return pages work.
  • Transaction emails are sent correctly.
  • WooCommerce order notes contain the expected payment result.
  • Your privacy policy and terms reflect the use of an external payment provider.
  • Your live credentials are not visible in logs, screenshots or public pages.

Troubleshooting

Maksu does not appear at checkout

Check that:

  • The plugin is installed and activated.
  • Maksu is enabled under WooCommerce → Settings → Payments.
  • The store currency is supported.
  • The payment method is available for the customer’s country.
  • Your Maksu account has the required payment methods enabled.
  • No conditional-payment plugin is hiding the gateway.
  • Your website and server caches have been cleared.

The customer cannot continue to payment

Check that:

  • The correct credentials have been entered.
  • Sandbox credentials are being used in sandbox mode.
  • Production credentials are being used in live mode.
  • There are no spaces before or after credential values.
  • The payment endpoint matches the selected environment.
  • HTTPS is working correctly.
  • Security, firewall, or caching tools are not blocking the payment request.

The payment succeeds but the order remains pending

Check that:

  • The store is publicly accessible.
  • The payment return and notification requests are not blocked.
  • Security plugins or firewalls allow communication with Maksu.
  • The order amount and currency match the payment request.
  • The WooCommerce logs contain no gateway or callback errors.
  • The correct production or sandbox environment is being used.

Do not manually mark an order as paid until the transaction has been confirmed in the Maksu merchant environment.

Additional support

When requesting technical support, provide the WooCommerce order number, plugin version, environment, timestamp and relevant error logs.

Remove passwords, private keys, personal customer information and payment credentials before sharing logs or screenshots.
sections.faq:
Do I need a Maksupay account?

Yes, you need to register for a Maksupay merchant account at https://maksupay.com/ to receive payments.

Which currencies are supported?

The plugin supports EUR and USD by default. You can configure additional currencies in the plugin settings.

Does this plugin support refunds?

Yes, you can process refunds directly from the WooCommerce order admin panel.

Is there a test mode?

Yes, you can enable test mode in the plugin settings to test payments without processing real transactions.

Does it work with WooCommerce Blocks?

Yes, the plugin includes full support for WooCommerce Blocks checkout.

Where can I find my Maksupay credentials?

Log in to your Maksupay merchant dashboard at https://maksupay.com/ to access your credentials.

1.1.4

  • Enhancement: Added clickable links to Maksu test tools and merchant onboarding pages in documentation

1.1.3

  • Fix: Improved signature validation to include all fields sent by Maksupay
  • Enhancement: Updated plugin name and author

1.1.2

  • Enhancement: Improved payment redirect handling for better user experience
  • Enhancement: Updated API endpoint configuration for improved reliability

1.1.1

  • Enhancement: Updated plugin description and installation documentation
  • Enhancement: Added comprehensive troubleshooting section
  • Enhancement: Added sandbox testing and live activation guides
  • Enhancement: Improved checkout flow testing documentation
  • Fix: Various documentation improvements and corrections

1.1.0

  • Security: Moved signature validation to execute first in confirm and cancel handlers to prevent processing of requests with invalid signatures

1.0.0

  • Initial release
  • Secure payment processing via Maksupay
  • Support for EUR and USD currencies
  • Test mode for sandbox testing
  • Debug mode for troubleshooting
  • Refund processing capability
  • WooCommerce Blocks checkout support
